# Report 8 tables (generated by results/exp8/report8.py)

Variants, all d=5, 5 rounds, p=0.003, data/d5_wide_x5, h48/l4, fp32, batch 512, 300000 steps, --compile, seeds 0, 1, 2. Baseline = the existing adaptive-stale models (--stale-prob 0.3, single fingerprint); B = the same command with --fingerprint multiscale (long = whole 2000-shot window, short = last 200 shots, short − long). static-wide = the existing static models trained on data/d5_wide_x5. Baseline and static-wide results are reused from results/exp6. Ensemble = mean of the 3 seeds' logits > 0 (fixed). Live: each model's own causal buffer; frozen: every channel from the nominal test set's fingerprint shots. Update every 200 shots. Streams pooled over stream seeds 0,1,2,3,4. McNemar exact, two-sided; p in 0.001–0.05 = weak evidence; no multiple-testing correction. The best WindowDEM is picked per phase after the fact.

## Decision rule (fixed in advance, same as round 7, computed here)

B passes if its ensemble beats the adaptive-stale ensemble at onset or after on bursts or bursts_big with p < 0.001, and is not worse than the adaptive-stale ensemble on later or drift steps in any regime (bursts, bursts_big, hot_qubit, telegraph) at p < 0.001. Live ensembles, pooled streams.

| variant | verdict | wins (onset/after, bursts/bursts_big, p < 0.001) | losses (later/drift, any regime, p < 0.001) |
|---|---|---|---|
| B multiscale | **FAILS** | bursts onset -0.0019 (p=2e-07) | bursts_big drift +0.0019 (p=4e-09); bursts_big later +0.0024 (p=2e-11) |
